decisions.reason: The valve-type change does not alter the existing no-drip requirement, and the same-message bowl-sealing requirement is already represented.
Choosing a simple open/close valve or tap does not change the flow-quality state; the same-message flow-rate constraint is already represented.
The valve-control change does not necessarily alter the spout-cleaning method, which is already updated by a same-message Event.
The valve-control mechanism does not change the spout's bottom location, barista-facing orientation, or easy-pouring goal.
The dispensing-valve decision does not change the 120V power source, battery policy, or V1 power architecture.
The source does not modify the general repeated-operation or event-use reliability requirement.
The valve or tap selection concerns dispensing control and does not change splash control during mixing.
The source specifies valve behavior but does not change the broader off-the-shelf component strategy.
